ddl.name: payment_status_stripeCheckoutSessionId_ck
ddl.value: ("status" IN ('pending', 'paid', 'expired', 'refunded') AND "stripeCheckoutSessionId" IS NOT NULL) OR ("status" NOT IN ('pending', 'paid', 'expired', 'refunded') AND "stripeCheckoutSessionId" IS NULL)

ddl.name: payment_status_completedAt_ck
